title: Noisy quality category
prompt: Given a quality-gate prompt with categories [missing citation, source conflict, unsupported market claim], rewrite it to omit the noisy category for now and draft the eval plan (examples, definition, precision/recall) that earns it back.
expected_answer: Option A. Keep the categories that engineers trust, drop `unsupported market claim` from the active list, and rebuild it as a classification problem with positive and negative examples, a tighter definition, and precision/recall measured on a labelled set before re-enabling.

rubric.check: noisy category removed from the active prompt only
re-enable gate is precision/recall on labelled examples, not schema compliance
